evidence.claim: National Scenic Byway designation followed in 2000.

flags: The cache describes designation and extensions but not the construction history of the individual highways.
Visit Utah gives 138 miles; Wikipedia gives approximately 83 miles for the older branching corridor. No single length or driving time is used.
Winter Quarters fatality totals differ (199, 200 and 246 across pages). Copy attributes the company’s 200 count and the alternative reports.

Year-round highway maintenance at Electric Lake does not establish current access: the Forest Service says weather and snowmelt affect opening and closing. Current draft’s year-round statement omitted.

Moments run from the Colton/Scofield end to Electric Lake, then via the SR 264/SR 31 junction to Huntington Reservoir on the Huntington arm. Winter Quarters is a separate excursion with no entry permission established. Access note checked only against cached Wikipedia.
Huntington Reservoir remains a short entry because the cache offers limited site-specific interpretation. The Idaho Herrett Center has a replica, not the skeleton identified in Price.
